name: Evodus
bio: Evodus is one of the named epigrammatists of the Greek Anthology. Paton’s Index of Authors gives no firm date for him.
This archive carries the 2 epigrams ascribed to the poet in the fifth volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Loeb, 1918): Book XVI: 116, 155.

poems.title: Book XVI, 116: On the Same
poems.author: Evodus
poems.text: THere were a horse without a head and a man lying unfinished: Nature, in sport, grafted him on the swift horse.

poems.title: Book XVI, 155: On the Same
poems.author: Evodus
poems.text: Echo the mimic, the lees of the voice, the tail of a word.
